service.description: The one scoped list of quotes (design §5 QuoteList, Home and the palette): orders of purpose SalesQuote whose selling part is of an organization of the caller's scope, the caller's and their teams' (or the organization's every one for SALES_TEAM_VIEW), never a Shop cart, a recurring base or another purpose's order; filtered by organization, customer, opportunity, owner (mine Y: the caller) or team, state (open, the default: Open, Requested and Proposed; draft; requested; proposed; cancelled; all, never a quote once placed, which is an order's, impl-sales P11), validity (expiring within seven days, expired), currency and text (id or name, ignoring case), paged in the query. Each row's customer (unnamed when the caller may not see the account), seller, total, validity, owner and revision. Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: validity
parameter.description: expiring or expired; empty for any

parameter.name: issue
parameter.description: P11: unsent, a quote with no issue standing (Quotes to send)

service.description: A draft quote (design §5 NewQuote) over create#Order: one selling part of an organization of the caller's scope (the one given, else the active or only one) for a customer that is an account of it or a shared one, one currency (the one given, else the opportunity's, else the seller's base currency), with or without a store of that organization (without one, X1: the seller's tax gateway), its validity on the part (from now unless given), the customer's postal address, the caller as its owner, the opportunity's team (else the caller's only team of the organization), a contact of the customer and the opportunity linked. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT and a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), an account it may not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or of another organization (CUSTOMER_INVALID), an opportunity of another organization or account (OPPORTUNITY_INVALID), a contact of another account (CONTACT_INVALID), another organization's store (STORE_INVALID), no currency (CURRENCY_REQUIRED) and a validity that ends before it starts (VALIDITY_INVALID). P12: from a template (templateOrderId), a copy made with clone#Order of a current template of the organization (its organization and currency when none is named; its validity days before the organization's), whose parentOrderId names the template, priced as of the quote's own date (each product line at the seller's price for the customer now, a fixed line keeping its price and reason, a line with no price left for the rep, each named in warnings); refuses a template the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not current (TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE), of another organization (TEMPLATE_INVALID) or in another currency (TEMPLATE_CURRENCY).

parameter.name: templateOrderId
parameter.description: P12: the quote template to copy

parameter.name: warnings
parameter.description: P12: a template line left without a price or not usable for the customer ({orderItemSeqId, reasonCode, productId})

service.description: OrderDetail's quote (design §5) as the caller may see it (SalesAccess.js quoteOf), else quoteFound false: its facts with names (an account the caller may not see unnamed), validity, owner, team and opportunity (when the caller sees it), its lines with their price provenance (the calculated basis, the source, an entered price's reason and actor) and tax, the totals of products, shipping and tax, the tax gateway that taxes it, the history of its audited fields, the customer's addresses and whether the caller may edit it (a draft and SALES_QUOTE_EDIT) or enter a free line (an approval rule covers it, or SALES_APPROVE), and (P9) the approvals it needs at its revision (preview#Quote's approval). No cost or margin.

A draft quote's name, validity (validFromDate, validThruDate on the part), the customer's reference (its PO, otherPartyOrderId) and address (one of the customer's). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED, naming the current one), a validity that ends before it starts (VALIDITY_INVALID) and another party's address (ADDRESS_INVALID).

A draft quote's line, new or changed (orderItemSeqId). A product line (ItemProduct, the default): a product usable for selling (check#ProductUsable, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) at the one resolver's price for the seller and the customer (get#SellerProductPrice), with its provenance and calculated basis; a changed quantity is repriced. An entered price (unitAmount) or a free line (freeLine Y) keeps the calculated basis with the value, the reason (overrideReason, OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED) and the actor; useCalculatedPrice Y returns to the calculated price. A free line or an entered zero is the rep's where an approval rule will need it approved (P9, the user's call of Nov 13: with no quote rule the manual-price rule, else a free-line, discount or floor rule it meets), elsewhere SALES_APPROVE's (FREE_LINE_DENIED); a product with no price the caller has not entered one for is refused (PRICE_UNAVAILABLE). A shipping charge line (ItemShipping): the amount the rep enters, a storeless quote's freight. Tax follows from the native order rules (X1). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees; refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a line not on the quote or a tax line (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE). P12: a quote template's draft too (the quote draft's line editor), for a template manager (SalesAccess.js requireTemplate: PERMISSION_DENIED, TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED once published), priced for no customer; an entered price is the template's fixed price.

A draft quote's line removed with its tax (OrderServices.delete#OrderItem, which retaxes the part). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees; refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED) and a line not on the quote or a tax line (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE). P12: a quote template's draft line too, for a template manager (PERMISSION_DENIED, TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED).

Whether the caller sees a quote (SalesAccess.js quoteOf: a seller of their sales scope, and the quote assigned to them or a team of theirs, or SALES_TEAM_VIEW) and may change it (SALES_QUOTE_EDIT): the record visibility of get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles for a quote not yet placed and its files, in every app. A call with no user sees none.

The safe explanation of a quote line's price for anyone who sees the quote (design §7, PriceExplain's Sales branch): the selected price, where it came from (a price, a customer price, a price list, the list price, an entered price with its reason, a free line), the calculated basis, the list price, the price list's name and today's price when it differs; never the trace, a cost or another party's price, which stay Products' for a holder of PRICE_VIEW. Refuses a quote the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a line that is no product line of it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

The one scoped list of requests for quote (design §5 QuoteRequestList, Home's counter): Requests of type RqtQuote whose organization (the OrgInternal party) is of the caller's scope, the caller's and their teams' (or the organization's every one for SALES_TEAM_VIEW); filtered by organization, customer, owner (mine Y: the caller) or team, state (open, the default: Submitted, Reviewed and In progress; awaiting: not quoted yet; quoted; declined; completed; all), overdue (the response wanted by a past date) and text (id or name, ignoring case), paged in the query. Each row's customer (unnamed when the caller may not see the account), owner, team, received and wanted dates, source and quotes. With kind repair: the open warranty claims of the scope whose current decision is a chargeable repair, or that a quote was made from, for a caller who makes quotes (SALES_QUOTE_EDIT) or reads the organization's (SALES_TEAM_VIEW), each named by its product only. Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

QuoteRequestDetail's request (design §5) as the caller may see it (SalesAccess.js quoteRequestOf), else requestFound false: its name, description, state, organization, customer (unnamed when the caller may not see the account), contact, owner, team, received and wanted dates and source; its lines (product, quantity, description, required date, the quotes each is in); the quotes made from it (a total only for a quote the caller sees); its revision and what the caller may do (change it, make a quote, decline it). A chargeable repair source (a warranty claim, see find#QuoteRequests) answers its customer and its lines' products and quantities alone: never its decision, diagnosis, fault text, people or conversation.

A customer's request for quote (design §5 NewQuoteRequest; "Create RFQ" on a message in Comms) over create#Request: an RqtQuote request, Submitted, of an organization of the caller's scope (the one given, else the active or only one), its customer an account of it or a shared one and its contact one of the customer's (else those the sender's address belongs to: a contact of exactly one account, or an account; never a new party), the caller its owner when they work for the organization and the team given (a current team of it, one of the caller's unless SALES_TEAM_MANAGE) or their only team there, its name, description, wanted date and lines. From a message (emailMessageId, communicationEventId, or chatRoomId and eventSeq): the message read as the caller may read it before anything is written (a message of a mailbox, room or thread they may not read answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, as a missing one), its subject and text the defaults, and the message with its files filed on the request; the same message again answers the request it made (alreadyApplied), or REQUEST_TAKEN when the caller cannot open it. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT and a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), another organization's account (CUSTOMER_INVALID), a contact of another (CONTACT_INVALID), another team (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and no owner or team (TEAM_REQUIRED).

The createQuoteRequest action of the mail client's rules (EmailRuleAction ErActCreateQuoteRequest, CX-MAIL-INTAKE): a received message to a sales team's plus-tag address, or to the team the action's value names, becomes an RqtQuote request of that team's organization in that team's queue: its subject the name, its text the description, the sender matched to an account or a contact of the organization (never a new party), and the message with its files filed on it. The message's Message-ID is its identity, so the same mail delivered twice makes one request. A team is taken only when the rule's owner works for its organization (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE otherwise) and holds SALES_QUOTE_EDIT (RULE_NOT_ALLOWED otherwise, nothing filed; check#LeadRuleOwner refuses such a rule when it is saved too). Answers stopProcessing, so a later rule (the lead intake's) does not take the same mail.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The team (partyId), or empty for the plus tag

service.description: An open request for quote's line, new or changed (requestItemSeqId), or removed (cancel Y: Cancelled, kept): a product the organization may sell (check#ProductUsable, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) or none with a description (ITEM_REQUIRED), a positive quantity (1 when not given), a description and a required date. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a request the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a closed request (REQUEST_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED, naming the current one) and a line not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

A draft quote from a request's selected lines (design §5 QuoteRequestDetail's Create quote): one quote through create#Quote and store#QuoteLine (every quote rule: the seller of the caller's scope, the customer an account of it, the caller its owner, the seller's price for the customer or an entered price with its reason), each line linked to its request line (RequestItemOrder), all in one transaction; the operation key answers a retry with the first quote (alreadyApplied), another request under it OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. The source: a request for quote the caller may change, open; or a warranty claim whose current decision is a chargeable repair (Customer Service's, see find#QuoteRequests), kept as it is, its quote named "Repair estimate" and its lines carrying none of the claim's fault text or decision. A first quote puts an RFQ In progress; nothing completes it. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a request the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a closed request (REQUEST_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), no lines (ITEMS_REQUIRED), a removed or unknown line (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), a line with no product (ITEM_PRODUCT_REQUIRED) and a request with no customer (CUSTOMER_REQUIRED), and whatever the quote rules refuse.

parameter.name: items
parameter.description: Each {requestItemSeqId, productId, quantity, unitAmount, overrideReason}: a line's product or quantity other than the request line's, an entered price with its reason

service.description: What declining a request for quote tells its requester (design §5 Decline RFQ): whether it can be told from here (the request came in by a mailbox still active, and has an address), the address (its first message's sender, else the contact's or the customer's email), the mailbox it goes from, the subject and the default text. Changes nothing. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on an open request the caller sees.

A request for quote declined (design §5 Decline RFQ): the reason as a note (REASON_REQUIRED), the request Cancelled with the resolution Rejected. With notify Y the requester is told, only at the address the preview showed (toAddress; RECIPIENT_CHANGED otherwise, to preview again), from the mailbox the request came in by (NOTIFY_UNAVAILABLE when none), with the caller's text (else the default): a mail answering the request's first message, filed on its conversation; a send that does not go waits in the mailbox's Outbox. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a request the caller sees; refuses a closed request (REQUEST_CLOSED) and a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED).

Whether the caller sees a request for quote (SalesAccess.js quoteRequestOf: an organization of their sales scope, and the request assigned to them or a team of theirs, or SALES_TEAM_VIEW) and may change it (SALES_QUOTE_EDIT, open): the record visibility of get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles for an RqtQuote request and its files, in every app. A call with no user sees none.

Internal (service/SalesQuoteRequest.secas.xml, on decide#WarrantyClaim's commit; the user's call of Nov 13, 2026): a warranty decision that is a chargeable repair (a charge estimate above zero), current on an open claim, tells the organization's default Sales team (its SalesPolicy in effect, Sales P9) on the topic SalesRepairToQuote: its current members who work for the organization and hold SALES_QUOTE_EDIT or SALES_TEAM_VIEW. The notice names the claim, its customer and a product, never its fault text, diagnosis, decision or the charge. No default team, no notice. Never fails: an error is logged.

Propose a draft quote (design §5; impl-sales P9 builds its approval guard, P10 the issue's checks): a draft the caller may edit, at its current revision, with lines and every approval it needs current at that revision (SalesApprovalServices.preview#Quote), moved to Proposed through OrderServices.propose#Order, so a direct call cannot propose an unapproved quote. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT; one being revised, Being changed, is one again), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), no lines (LINES_REQUIRED) and an approval not given (APPROVAL_REQUIRED, naming the rules). P10's issue checks: one seller and customer on every part (PARTS_INVALID), each product line priced (PRICE_UNAVAILABLE) and usable for selling (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), a total of zero or more (TOTAL_INVALID), a validity set and in the future (VALIDITY_REQUIRED, QUOTE_EXPIRED, VALIDITY_INVALID), and the tax current (F151: a storeless quote of a gateway seller with no address of its own is taxed at the customer's address, kept, and refused once with the new total, TAX_UPDATED; with no address at all ADDRESS_REQUIRED).

The scoped list of quote templates (design §5 TemplateList, NewQuote's template choice): orders of purpose SalesQuoteTemplate of the organizations of the caller's scope. A Sales reader gets the current ones (published and not ended); a template manager (SALES_QUOTE_EDIT with SALES_TEAM_MANAGE or SALES_CONFIGURE) those of the state asked: open (the default: drafts, scheduled and current), current, draft, scheduled, ended or all. Filtered by organization, text (id or name, ignoring case) and product, paged in the query; each row's organization, currency, published interval, state and line count. Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

QuoteTemplateDetail's template as the caller may see it (SalesAccess.js templateOf), else templateFound false: its name, description, organization, currency, default validity, state and published interval, the template it replaces and its successor, its lines in the quote draft's shape with each line's pricing (priced on the quote's date, a fixed price and its reason, or a charge), the history of its audited fields and what the caller may do (edit and publish a draft, start a successor, end it, start a quote from a current one). No cost or margin.

A quote template's header (design §5 NewTemplate, TemplateHeader): a new draft (name, an organization of the caller's scope, description, currency, else the organization's base currency, and the days a quote made from it is valid), a draft's changes at its revision (orderId; its currency only while it has no lines, CURRENCY_FIXED), or the successor of a published, scheduled or ended template (predecessorOrderId): a draft copy of it made with clone#Order, its lines included, that replaces it once published. Needs a template manager (SALES_QUOTE_EDIT with SALES_TEAM_MANAGE or SALES_CONFIGURE; PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a template the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a change of a published one (TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED), a successor of a draft (TEMPLATE_DRAFT) or of a template that has one (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED) and a validity that is not a number of days (VALIDITY_INVALID).

A template draft published (design §5 TemplateHeader): its part's validity from its start (now, or a later date) through its end (none, or a later date); the template it succeeds (its parentOrderId) ends at that start, so the earlier quotes keep their terms and new ones copy the successor. A published template is not changed. Needs a template manager on a draft (PERMISSION_DENIED, TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a draft with no lines (LINES_REQUIRED), a start before today (DATE_INVALID), an end before the start (VALIDITY_INVALID) and a predecessor another successor replaced (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS).

An example quote of a template the caller sees (design §5 TemplatePreview): each line priced for a customer (an account of the organization, CUSTOMER_INVALID for another's; none: the seller's own price) in the template's currency as of a date (now when not given), with its source and warnings (no price, a product not usable for selling to the customer, a fixed price beside today's calculated one), and the total; no tax. Writes nothing; the template not seen answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.
